A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PARSE research and contain 34 pages, including Appendices A–E. Their text, equations, figures and tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original concept-erasure experiments, quantitative comparisons, ablations and qualitative evaluations in Section 5 and Appendices D–E.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results, including PARSE evaluations in Tables 1–13 and the accompanying robustness, utility and sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same two-stage knowledge search, preservation-aware value-space projection, textual-inversion trigger discovery, adaptive expansion and multi-concept extension.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same nudity, artistic-style, object and multi-concept erasure tasks. I2P, Imagenette, MS-COCO, SEE and EraseBench coverage, including the additional appendix targets, is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 and the expanded comparisons in Tables 3–6 retain the same comparator sets. The newly cited Optic-Net paper is background literature, not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The SD 1.4 backbone, 5,000-image MS-COCO utility evaluation, attack procedures, metrics and experimental settings remain unchanged in Section 5.1 and Appendices C–E.

E4.justification: Table 2's component ablations, Figures 6–9's analyses, qualitative examples and Appendix E's retrieval, pooling, hyperparameter, VLM and trigger-finder investigations are retained without additions or revisions.

E5.justification: Seed information and statistical reporting are unchanged, including averaging CFG embeddings over three random seeds in Figure 16 and Appendix E.3. No repeated-run information, uncertainty intervals or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative examples are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 1 retains PARSE target ASRs of 2.09, 0.00 and 0.00 for nudity, Van Gogh and garbage truck, respectively; appendix result entries also remain identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations remain unchanged, including the BEUS definition and Appendix A's boundedness and monotonicity derivations. No proof or mathematical correction is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free PARSE, preservation-aware adaptive erasure, BEUS and robustness–utility balance. Added citations and figure pointers do not change their scope.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and Section 7's limitations remain unchanged, including computational overhead, vocabulary and compositional constraints, linear projection, dependence on trigger discovery and scaling to larger backbones.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose the same iteration limit, expansion threshold, textual-inversion optimization settings, hardware, runtime and storage information. The project-page link and appendix technical details are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 1 adds a nine-reference citation cluster to the safety/compliance motivation. It includes one newly listed work, Kamran et al.'s Optic-Net (v2 reference 23); the other eight already appeared in v1's Appendix B. The related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds explicit Figure 1 and Figure 2 pointers, updates the arXiv version stamp and revises citation numbering and bibliographic metadata. Some publication records become preprint records, and several publication years disappear. The prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Citation and bibliography edits cause limited text reflow and move reference entries across pages 16–20. All 16 figures and 13 tables retain their displays and organization; no scientific figure or table is added, removed or redrawn.

improvement.justification: Scientific content and evidence remain unchanged. The added Figure 1/2 pointers modestly improve navigation, but bibliographic clarity declines: several entries lose publication years, and the Pairwise Meta Learning reference (v1 reference 48; v2 reference 49) acquires duplicated venue/year text. These concrete editorial regressions outweigh the small navigation benefit, producing a limited overall decline.
